scientific_integrity: The asymptotic theorem is derived analytically from the published exact B=1 success formula and published QC converse; finite numerical checks are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Nonvanishing exact-message success is weaker than reliable decoding; no claim is made that the QQ decoder is optimal or that reliable decoding extends beyond p<1/16.
title: Persistent quantum memory keeps constant simplex-decoding success across the full nontrivial BSC range
